description:
Found by defk-ds0: lib/examples.ex sits in the library's lib/, so every app depending on defk also compiles and ships Examples.Kernels (0.36 s C compile, ~75 KB in the release). Move the examples out of lib/ (e.g. test/support or examples/, compiled via elixirc_paths only in :dev/:test) without breaking demo.exs, bench/ and the tests that use them.

Done when a fresh app with a path/hex dep on defk compiles no defk example kernels, and demo.exs, bench/*.exs and mix test still work.

comments.text: Done: defk-djy.1 moved lib/examples.ex to test/support/examples.ex; elixirc_paths(:dev) now adds that one file so demo.exs and bench/*.exs work again (both ran), and ex_doc filters Examples.Kernels out. Deps compile as :prod, so dependent apps compile no example kernels.

title: Don't compile defk's example kernels into dependent apps
